g.text: The on-chain part of Netra. Each published check is anchored here so anyone can confirm later that the grade they
see is the one that was published, and that no registry serial range backs two claims.
The contract does not mint, bridge or burn credits. Credits stay in their registry (Verra, Gold Standard). It only
records a fingerprint of each check and of the serial ranges behind it. Minting tokens from retired credits can itself
create double counting, which is why Verra banned it in 2022.
